prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1357; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was making a left turn. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page, so that we may evaluate the claim properly. We also request written confirmation of the claim number assigned to this matter and the name of the adjuster handling it.

Please take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, dashcam or surveillance footage, witness statements, repair and total-loss records, and all recorded calls or electronic messages concerning the incident. Please ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or overwritten while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt response.
